title: Send Ollama chat sampling parameters in options

files.patch:
@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@
 - [SECURITY]: A change which fixes a security vulnerability.
 
 ## [Unreleased]
+- [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1077] Send `temperature`, `seed`, `top_p`, `max_tokens` (as `num_predict`) and the other sampling parameters of `Langchain::LLM::Ollama#chat` in `options`, where Ollama reads them; at the top level they were ignored, including the default `temperature: 0.0`.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1073] Raise `Langchain::LLM::Anthropic`'s default `max_tokens` from 256 to 16,000; Claude Sonnet 5 and later, Haiku 5.5 and Opus 5 and later think by default within that cap, so they often stopped before writing any text and `#chat_completion` returned `nil`.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1072] Ask the LLM with `#chat` in `Langchain::Chunker::Semantic`, the Ragas evals and `Vectorsearch::Base#similarity_search_with_hyde`; they called `#complete`, which Google Gemini, Vertex AI and Mistral AI don't implement, and the semantic chunker passed `max_tokens_to_sample:`, which `Langchain::LLM::Anthropic#complete` rejected.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1069] Honor `tables:` and `exclude_tables:` in `Langchain::Tool::Database#list_tables` and `#dump_schema`, list the key columns of a composite primary key, and drop the trailing comma from the schema of a table without a primary key.

@@ -286,6 +300,17 @@ def auth_headers

+    # Ollama ignores sampling parameters at the top level of /api/chat, like #complete and #embed
+    # already send them. Values given in `options:` win over the unified parameters.
+    def move_chat_options(parameters)
+      options = CHAT_OPTIONS.each_with_object({}) do |(param, option), moved|
+        moved[option] = parameters.delete(param) if parameters.key?(param)
+      end
+      return parameters if options.empty?
+
+      parameters.merge(options: options.merge(parameters[:options] || {}))
+    end

+    context "with sampling parameters" do
+      include WebMock::API
+
+      let(:body) { {"model" => "llama3.2", "message" => {"role" => "assistant", "content" => "Hi"}, "done" => true}.to_json }
+      let(:sent) { [] }
+
+      # Outside a cassette the suite disables WebMock; this stubs the endpoint for these examples only
+      around do |example|
+        WebMock.enable!
+        example.run
+      ensure
+        WebMock.reset!
+        WebMock.disable!
+      end
+
+      before do
+        stub_request(:post, "#{default_url}/api/chat").to_return do |request|
+          sent << JSON.parse(request.body)
+          {body: body}
+        end
+      end
+
+      it "sends them in options, where Ollama reads them" do
+        subject.chat(messages: messages, temperature: 0.4, seed: 7, top_p: 0.9, max_tokens: 50, stop: ["\n"])
+
+        expect(sent.first).not_to include("temperature", "seed", "top_p", "max_tokens", "stop")
+        expect(sent.first["options"]).to eq("temperature" => 0.4, "seed" => 7, "top_p" => 0.9, "num_predict" => 50, "stop" => ["\n"])
+      end
+
+      it "sends the default temperature in options" do
+        subject.chat(messages: messages)
+
+        expect(sent.first["options"]).to eq("temperature" => 0.0)
+      end
+
+      it "lets options: override them" do
+        subject.chat(messages: messages, temperature: 0.4, options: {temperature: 0.9, num_ctx: 4096})
+
+        expect(sent.first["options"]).to eq("temperature" => 0.9, "num_ctx" => 4096)
+      end
+    end
+
     context "when passing a block" do
       let(:response) { subject.chat(messages: messages) { |resp| streamed_responses << resp } }
       let(:streamed_responses) { [] }
